metric_definitions.recall: A4: opportunities (affected trials whose change landed, any status, counted once) with a correction that is correct (fixtures.correct_correction), confirmed in the client's own session record (memex/evaluation/transcripts.py), after the change and before the first affected mutation or as the denial of it; analysis.timely_correction
metric_definitions.interception: diagnostic only, Part A's original recall: first necessary boundary denied; analysis.intercepted
metric_definitions.precision: Part A: correction events at necessary boundaries / all correction events
metric_definitions.false_interruption: Part A: denied unaffected boundaries / all unaffected boundaries
